title: Mini Shipping Container $4.63-$5.16 + Delivery ($15 Spend) @ AliExpress
body:

Does Aliexpress ship to a 3rd party in China?

[doperst] These are cute, but I believe this is their normal price.
[dosada] Love the effort they put in the description.
Size: no doll 😂😂😂
